# Well-known sites a copied page may load from without asking. A name also covers its subdomains
# (fonts.gstatic.com is covered by gstatic.com). Any other site a copy loads from is named in the app,
# which asks once: sites allowed or blocked there go into the user's own list (~/.claude/waib/hosts.json)
# and are not asked about again.

# top 100,000 of the Tranco list (https://tranco-list.eu, list ID 64VVX, 2026-10-16), a research ranking of
# popular sites built to resist manipulation. Popular is not the same as harmless, but copies run no scripts
# and an address of this computer or network is never allowed, whatever the list says.
